column1: # softfloat on z80, gcc (spike backends, fork spike/backends cd4fbdff8 (native 32-bit add/sub/move/compare), gcc 17.0.0 master d77bceec) vs hand asm, built 2026-11-04 01:27 CET, cc1 md5 38cd2b7db804f89e26de9aecd70fe441, sources runtime/compiler-rt (lib/fp/f32/*.c, lib/int/int32.c; sf32_6502 = config/6502/sf32_6502.c, one translation unit per operation), ucsim_z80 0.8.15, sdasz80/sdldz80 SDCC 4.5.0, vectors runtime/compiler-rt/tests/z80/gen_f32.py (700 records); records with a NaN input are left out of add/sub/mul/div/ftoi/ftou (the C propagates the payload, the hand asm returns the canonical NaN); clk = (run - bare-ret stub run)/records, bytes = _CODE of the whole link minus the stub link (gcc: every f32 object plus helpers) / _CODE of the hand .s files; every gcc cell 0 fails; hand cells carried from 2026-11-03 (hand .s files unchanged since a286a52c00).
